_note: Power consumed inside the habitat, in kWh per day, split by category. The categories are yours to shape: rename a label, add one, remove one — the key is the stable name in the record, the label is what the station shows. Days are filed as "1": { "heating": 1.1, "food": 0.5, ... } — on the Habitat tab of mission control or here; a save is live within a couple of seconds. Emptied of its days by the reset; the categories stay.
